tactics.title: Tactics board
tactics.name: Plan name
tactics.noLevel: Load a level under Level to plan on it; without one the board is a flat plane.
tactics.hint.select: Click a figure, waypoint, route, area or note to select it; Shift+click adds or removes, Shift+drag draws a box, Ctrl+A takes everything in this step. Delete removes the selection (after asking).
tactics.hint.selectShort: Click to select, Shift+click to add, Shift+drag for a box; drag the gizmo to move or turn.
tactics.hint.more: The whole hint, with the help on (F1)
tactics.hint.place: Click the level to put the chosen figure there. R turns it.
tactics.hint.throw: Click the thrower, then where it should land: the ring is how far this throw reaches, a landing past it comes in to its edge, and the arc is the real flight. The chosen utility appears where it lands.
tactics.hint.area: Click the middle, then the edge.
tactics.hint.note: Click where the note goes and type its text; its colour, size and when it shows are set below, and for a selected note in Selected.
tactics.hint.erase: Click a figure, route, area, note or drawing to remove it from this step on.
tactics.hint.moving: Click where the selected figure goes in this step.
tactics.hint.finish: Enter, a double click, a right click or Esc finishes it; Backspace takes the last point back.
tactics.figureScaleHint: 1× is true size; larger reads better from far above.
tactics.label: Label
tactics.clearConfirm: Clear the whole plan? Undo brings it back.
tactics.file.bad: That file is not a board this viewer reads: {reason}
tactics.addStep: Add a step; figures start it where their routes ended
tactics.valorant.failed: Could not fetch the maps from valorant-api.com: {reason}
tactics.gizmo.title: Transform
tactics.gizmo.hint: Drag an arrow to move along it, a square across its plane, the centre over the level; rings turn. Hold Ctrl to snap to the grid or the angle step. Esc cancels a drag.
tactics.speed.source.official: Speeds from the game's published values (see Movement speeds in the docs).
tactics.speed.source.approx: Approximate speeds (measured or typical; see Movement speeds in the docs). Set your own where you know better.
tactics.route.title: Route: {total} s, there at {at}
tactics.timing.title: Timing
tactics.timing.realTime: Play in real time (a step lasts until its slowest route arrives); either way no figure moves faster than its top speed
tactics.timing.hint: Times follow the level's surface and slope at each mode's speed for the figure; CS2 maps are in game units (39.37 a metre).
tactics.timeline.title: Arrivals
tactics.tele.title: Compare with match data
tactics.tele.hint: Load CS2 match tables of this map (or use the loaded data) to see how fast players really got where your plan goes.
tactics.tele.error: Could not read the match data: {reason}
tactics.tele.noRounds: the loaded data has no round times
tactics.tele.speedsHint: Real speeds in m/s, between samples while moving.
tactics.tele.noStates: The data has no movement state (walking, crouching) columns.
tactics.tele.compareHint: Select a routed figure or its route to compare its time with what players achieved.
tactics.tele.compare: Fastest observed {fastest} s ({who}), p10 {p10} s, median {median} s over {n} runs; your plan {plan} s.
tactics.tele.none: No player in the data went from there to there.
tactics.hint.waypoints: Click a figure, then each waypoint: it walks them when played. With several figures selected, the route is the group's (each keeps its place in the group). Begun off every figure it is a free arrow.
tactics.hint.measure: Click points to measure the way through them in metres, with the time it takes running.
tactics.draft.finish: {n, plural, one {# waypoint} other {# waypoints}}{group, plural, one {} other { for # figures}} · Enter, double click, right click or Esc to finish
tactics.measure.label: {m} m · {run} s running
tactics.removeConfirm: {n, plural, one {Remove the selected item?} other {Remove the # selected items?}} Undo brings it back.
tactics.layers.title: Layers
tactics.layers.activeHint: New figures, routes, areas, notes and drawings go on this layer.
tactics.layers.renameHint: Click to draw on it, double-click to rename it.
tactics.layers.shown: Shown: what is on it is drawn and played. Hidden: neither.
tactics.layers.locked: Locked: drawn and played, but nothing on it can be picked or changed.
tactics.layers.duplicateHint: A copy of the active layer to work on; the original is hidden, and routes of figures on other layers stay those figures' routes.
tactics.layers.upHint: Move the layer up: its routes play over the ones below
tactics.layers.removeConfirm: Remove the layer {name} and the {n} things on it? Undo brings them back.
tactics.layers.only: Draw only the active layer's routes (the others still play)
tactics.layers.lockedActive: The active layer is locked: nothing new can go on it.
tactics.layers.conflicts: {n, plural, one {# figure has} other {# figures have}} routes in this step on more than one shown layer; the upper layer's route plays.
tactics.layers.hint: Put each squad, plan or alternative on its own layer. Hide a layer to leave it out of the view and of playback; lock it to keep it from being changed.
tactics.author: Your name
tactics.authorPlaceholder: Signed on saved boards and shared edits
tactics.autosave.restored: The board you left was restored from this browser ({at}).
tactics.autosave.full: The board is too large for this browser to keep: save it to a file.
tactics.autosave.none: The board is kept in this browser a moment after each change, where the browser allows it.
tactics.speed.top: Top speed {v} m/s ({kmh} km/h): no route, wanted time or move between steps makes it faster.
tactics.keys.title: Keyframes at {at} ({s} s)
tactics.keys.remove: Remove the key at this moment
tactics.keys.aiming: Click on the level where it should point at this moment; Esc stops.
tactics.keys.hint: Angles from the hull's forward, right and up positive. Pick the moment with the time slider under the view; between keys a value turns the short way, before the first and after the last it holds.
tactics.keys.offBoard: The figure is not on the board at this moment.
tactics.route.wantHint: When to be at this waypoint, seconds from the step's start: the way there is spread to arrive then, never faster than the figure's top speed.
tactics.route.late: Waypoint {point}: wanted at {want} s, but at top speed it gets there at {got} s.
tactics.checks.none: Every figure keeps within its top speed.
tactics.checks.title: Speed limits ({n})
tactics.checks.late: Step {step}: {who} cannot be at waypoint {point} by {given} s; at top speed it is there at {needs} s.
tactics.checks.slide: Step {step}: {who} moves to its next place without a route; at top speed that takes {needs} s, so the step lasts that long instead of {given} s.
tactics.checks.squeezed: Step {step}: {who}'s route takes {needs} s at top speed; the step lasts that long instead of its set {given} s.
tactics.timeHint: Drag to see the plan at any moment and to set keyframes there; ▶ plays from here.
tactics.hint.draw: Drag on the level to draw with the pen or the highlighter; for a circle click the middle, then the edge. The camera does not turn while this tool is in hand: fly with the keys, or turn with the right button.
tactics.note.startNowHint: Start it at the moment shown (the time slider)
tactics.throw.reach: Reaches {m} m on the flat (launched at {speed} m/s, gravity {g} m/s²).
tactics.throw.src.public: Real-world figures; the game may differ.
tactics.mission.replace: Put the mission in place of the board? Undo brings the board back.
tactics.mission.done: Read {units} units in {groups} groups, {airbases} airbases and FARPs, {zones} zones and {markers} markers; each side is on its own layer.
tactics.mission.map: Set on {map}: load that level to plan on its ground.
tactics.dcs.counts: {groups, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}}, {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}, {waypoints, plural, one {# waypoint} other {# waypoints}}
tactics.dcs.base.patchNone: the mission it came from (not open)
tactics.dcs.nothing: Nothing changed: the file would be the same.
tactics.dcs.untouched: {n, plural, one {# group left as it was} other {# groups left as they were}}
tactics.dcs.warnings: What the mission cannot hold as the board has it
tactics.dcs.warn.retyped: {group}: a unit changed to another kind is now a {what}; check its loadout and livery in the Mission Editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.airfield-dropped: {group}: a takeoff or landing at an airfield is no longer on the route.
tactics.dcs.warn.ground: {group}: {n, plural, one {# waypoint drawn on the ground is} other {# waypoints drawn on the ground are}} flown at the height of the waypoint before.
tactics.dcs.warn.removed: {n, plural, one {# group taken out} other {# groups taken out}}: triggers that name them no longer find them.
tactics.dcs.warn.static: {group}: objects placed on the board that are not units are not written.
tactics.dcs.warn.no-country: {group}: the mission has no country on that side to put it in.
tactics.dcs.warn.new-air: {group}: a new flight starts in the air with a default fuel load and no weapons; set them in the Mission Editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.type-guess: {what}: no type of its own in the game, written as the one named.
tactics.dcs.warn.fuel: {what}: a default fuel load; check it in the Mission Editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.patrol-ground: {group}: DCS has no patrol task for ground units or ships; the route is written without it.
tactics.dcs.warn.air-only: {group}: {what} is a task for aircraft only.
tactics.dcs.warn.sweep-ground: {group}: DCS has no sweep task for ground units.
tactics.dcs.warn.no-target: {group}: {what} needs another group on the board to act on.
tactics.dcs.warn.state: {group}: {what} is a state this kind of unit does not have in the game.
tactics.dcs.warn.game-task: {group}: {what} is not a task the board can write; it is left out.
tactics.dcs.warn.skipped: {n, plural, one {# figure is} other {# figures are}} not a unit (markers, weapons) and not written.
tactics.dcs.warn.start: Tasks set to start later than their waypoint start at the waypoint in DCS.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-task: {group}: {what} needs a trigger in War Thunder's mission editor; it is not written.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-count: {group}: a War Thunder unit is one flight or platoon; {n, plural, one {# figure} other {# figures}} on the board stay one unit.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-player: No Blue unit for the player: choose one in the mission editor.
tactics.mission.openHint: A mission file as the board: DCS World (.miz), War Thunder (.blk), Arma 3 (mission.sqm or a mission .pbo), IL-2 Great Battles (.Mission, .msnbin), Falcon BMS (.ini, .cam, .tac) or Arma Reforger (.layer). Each side goes on its own layer, and the mission's level is loaded when the levels folder has it. Save as mission writes the board back into it.
tactics.mission.saveHint: Writes the board as a mission for its game: into the mission it came from, or as a new one.
tactics.mission.missing: {name} is not open in this session: pick it again to write into it, or write a new mission.
tactics.mission.levelFound: Its level, {name}, is loaded from the levels folder.
tactics.arma.where: Arma 3 reads mission.sqm from the mission's folder (missions\<name>.<world>); a mission .pbo goes into MPMissions.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-task: {group}: {what} has no Arma 3 waypoint; it is not written.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-crew: {group}: new vehicles get a stock crew of their side; check the seats in Eden.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-loose-route: {group}: an empty vehicle or a lone object has no waypoints in Arma 3; put it in a group in Eden.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-air: {group}: a new aircraft starts where it stands on the board; set it flying or on a runway in Eden.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-new: A new Arma 3 mission for {what}: put mission.sqm into a mission folder named <name>.{what}, and save it once in Eden so it lists the addons it needs.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-text: The mission.sqm was binarised; it is written as text, which Arma 3 reads the same.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-type: {group}: {what} was changed to another kind; IL-2 keeps its type: change it in the mission editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-task: {group}: {what} needs a command in IL-2's mission editor; it is not written.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-no-entity: {group}: has no entity in the mission, so its new waypoints are not written.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-new: A new IL-2 mission: check the map's season, clouds and the planes' payloads in the mission editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-binary: Saved as the editor's text .Mission, not as .msnbin: open it in IL-2's mission editor, which saves the binary form.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-new: A new cartridge holds only the steerpoints: copy its [STPT] section into the pilot's <callsign>.ini, or pick that file to write into.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-no-route: No flight with a route: the cartridge's steerpoints are left empty.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-stpt-many: {group}: {n} steerpoints; the cartridge holds 24, the rest are left out.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-ppt-many: {n} threat areas; the cartridge holds 15, the rest are left out.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-ppt-code: {what}: a threat is named by a code of up to three letters from BMS's Ppt.ini (SA2, AAA ...); written as its first three letters.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-lines: {n} lines; the cartridge holds four lines of six points, the rest are left out.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-task: {group}: {what} has no Reforger waypoint; it is not written.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-cycle: {group}: a new Cycle waypoint repeats nothing yet; choose the waypoints it repeats in the Workbench.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-sf-route: {group}: Scenario Framework slot waypoints are only moved; add or remove them in the Workbench.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-loose-route: {group}: a character or vehicle on its own has no waypoints in Reforger; put it in a group in the Workbench.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-count: {group}: a Reforger group is one figure on the board; {n, plural, one {# figure stays} other {# figures stay}} one group.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-retype: {group}: a figure changed to another kind keeps its prefab; change it in the Workbench.
tactics.dcs.warn.rf-no-prefab: {group}: there is no stock Reforger prefab for this kind of unit (ships, aircraft); it is not written.
